title: Subscription Salvage Binder: Rapid Renewal Risk Playbook
body:
PURPOSE
This is a compact, action-first binder for high-risk subscription renewals — intended for CSMs and AMs who need a fast, prioritized set of plays, templates, and an exec-escalation packet. Keep one copy per risky account in the customer folder and update during sprint touchpoints.

SCOPE & WHEN TO USE
- Applies to mid-market and enterprise accounts flagged by the Renewal Risk Score >= 7 (see scoring rubric below).
- Use when: critical usage drop, unresolved product blockers, contract at 30-90 days to renewal, or executive churn signals.

QUICKSTART: 48-HOUR TRIAGE (what to do first)
1) Confirm facts (prep, 4 bullets)
   - Renewal date, current ARR, primary contact hierarchy (procurement, champion, exec sponsor).
   - Last 30/60/90 day usage trend snapshots (embeds, API calls, avg latency) — screenshot.
   - Open support & engineering tickets impacting product value.
   - Commercial terms on table: discount threshold remaining, legal blockers, PO cadence.
2) One-sentence problem statement for the exec packet
   - Example: "RetailCo is reducing API usage 45% M/M; procurement paused pilot expansion due to latency & missing SSO scopes; contract expires 2026-03-31."
3) Immediate triage actions (assign owners, 24/48 hr)
   - Owner: CSM — schedule 30m sync with champion within 24h.
   - Owner: Solutions Eng — triage top customer blocker within 48h and produce go/no-go remediation note.
   - Owner: Sales/AM — confirm commercial levers available within 24h (list thresholds).

RISK SCORING RUBRIC (use numeric 0-10, add rationale)
- Usage decline magnitude (0-3 points)
- Severity of product blocker (0-3)
- Exec engagement health (0-2)
- Contract / commercial friction (0-2)
Touchpoints: total score -> low 0-3, medium 4-6, high 7-10. Include one line justification on risk doc.

PRIORITIZED SAVE PLAYS (start with 1 and progress)
1) "Operational Band-Aid" (low friction, fast): temporary routing/fallback, bypass a non-blocking feature, provide a short-term config change to restore value.
   - Timeline: 48–72 hours.
   - Cost: engineering hours (estimate).
2) "ROI Re-Run Workshop" (re-engage execs): 60–90 minute executive workshop with finance/ops to re-calc realized+projected ROI including new mitigations. Deliverable: one-slide ROI addendum.
   - Owners: CSM + Solutions Eng.
   - When: within 7 days.
3) "Extension + Pilot Augmentation" (commercial play): offer a 60–90 day extension with usage-based credits or extra onboarding support (SLA uplift) in exchange for committed expansion conversation.
   - Legal: templated amendment.
   - Finance: pre-approved discount band required.
4) "Escalation to Exec Sponsor" (if other plays fail): deploy the exec packet (3 slides) and request a 20-minute exec review with your VP/customer exec.
   - Outcome options: green (commit to expand), amber (extension & remediation), red (no renewal).

SCRIPTS & TEMPLATES
- 30m Champion Outreach (CSM) — short script
  "Hi <Champion>, quick check: we saw usage drop and open tickets X/Y. Are you available for a 30m sync tomorrow to align on what we can do to restore value before <renewal_date>?"
- Exec Escalation Email (AM -> VP + Customer Exec)
   Subject: "Action requested: <Customer> renewal risk & proposed quick wins"
   Body (bullet): 1) One-line problem 2) Key metrics impacted 3) Immediate fixes planned & owners 4) Ask: 20m exec sync + decision window (7 days)
- Legal Amendment Snippet (for extensions)
   "Term Extension: 60 days from original expiry. Agreed credits: X. Pilot deliverables: Y. Both parties sign within 10 business days."

ESCALATION PACKET (3-slide summary — attach to all VP outreach)
Slide 1: Snapshot (1-line problem, renewal date, ARR at risk, key contacts)
Slide 2: Evidence & impact (usage charts, top-2 production blockers, support ticket count & severity)
Slide 3: Recommended plays (timeline, owners, commercial ask, decision request)
Include an appendix in the packet: short fixes log, technical remediation ETA, and any legal pre-approvals.

MITIGATION CHECKLIST BY FUNCTION (fast reference)
- CSM: confirm contacts; lead ROI workshop; coordinate exec packet; weekly QBR cadence.
- Solutions Eng: triage P0s; create mitigation plan; ETA + rollback plan; stand-up customer debug session.
- Product: prioritize hotspot to next sprint or provide temporary toggle; ship patch notes to customer.
- Sales/AM: confirm discount band, extension approval, contracts owner; prepare amendment draft.
- Finance/Legal: expedite amendment review; pre-clear credits + billing alignment.
- SRE/Infra: investigate latency/availability anomalies; provide root cause summary.

DECISION WINDOWS & ESCALATION PATH
- Day 0-2: Triage and fixes. If unresolved, escalate to Solutions Eng lead and AM.
- Day 3-7: Execute ROI workshop or offer extension. If still unresolved, assemble exec packet and request VP attention.
- Day 8-14: Final commercial offer and legal amendment. If customer declines, prepare churn handoff (postmortem).

MEASURING SUCCESS (how to know a save worked)
- Usage recovered to >= 85% of baseline OR
- Customer signs extension or expansion with committed ARR uplift 
- Number of open severity-1/2 tickets drops by >=75% within 14 days
- Exec sponsor re-commits to roadmap item(s) in writing

POST-SAVE RETROSPECTIVE (required whenever save executed)
- 30-day retro template (one-pager) with sections: timeline, what moved the needle, lingering risks, product commitments, commercial concessions, owner sign-off. Attach to the account folder and link to QBR.

PLAYBOOK PITFALLS & CHEAT SHEET (lessons learned)
- Don’t over-discount upfront — use time-limited extension offers first.
- Avoid endless tactical fixes without an exec-level ROI conversation.
- Be explicit with decision windows in all outreach.
- Document everything in the customer folder (tickets, emails, exec responses, amendment drafts).

TRACKING: SAMPLE FIELDS TO ADD TO ACCOUNT RISK SHEET
- Risk score (0-10)
- Primary reason (short text)
- Suggested play (one of the prioritized plays)
- Owners (CSM / SE / AM)
- Next action + due date
- Commercial ask (free credits, extension, discount band)
- Escalation level (none / VP / CRO)

NOTES TO SELF / OPEN QUESTIONS (work-in-progress)
- Add a short checklist for GDPR/data residency concerns for private deployments (customer-specific).
- Validate finance pre-approval matrix for common discount tiers.
- Explore a small standardized legal amendment template repository for 30/60/90-day extensions.

CONTACTS (internal rapid-rescue roster)
- CSM escalation: Asha Patel (lead); backup: Marco Ruiz
- Solutions Eng rapid: Evelyn Chen
- Legal liaison: Priya Anand
- Finance approvals: Rahul Desai

ATTACHMENTS TO ADD WHEN FINALIZING
- Usage dashboards (pngs)
- Top 5 support tickets export (csv)
- Draft amendment (docx)
- Exec packet PDF

REVISION LOG
- 2025-11-03: initial draft (Asha)
- 2025-12-12: added ROI workshop template (Evelyn)
- 2026-02-15: tightened 48-hour triage and added decision windows (Marco)

END OF BINDER

(Quick reminder: keep this file short and attach evidence files in the account folder. This is a working doc — update after every save attempt.)
